title: UrlResponse
description: Schema enforced on Claude API output when generating a sample UrlResponse. Used in schema_runner.py (Part 3.3). Matches the OpenAPI component defined in specs/url-shortener.yaml.

shortCode.description: The generated or custom short code. REQ: FR-001, ADR-04.

longUrl.description: The original long URL. REQ: FR-001.

alias.description: Custom alias if provided, else null. REQ: FR-007.

expiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp, or null if no TTL set. REQ: FR-009.

isActive.description: False after soft-delete or expiry. REQ: FR-005, FR-006.
